COMPONENT_SET.detail: Current controlling packetSet still declares EXP102 primary filing, EXP104 certificate of service, EXP106 proposed order and conditional FEE102 in order 1–4. Current rendered-artifacts manifest still carries both 17-page fixtures in that order.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.detail: Current actual-writes.json is byte-identical to the VF23 input and both current fixture PDFs hash to the retained VF23 PDFs. The current map factMap and writable anchors are unchanged: the same participant/county/case-number prefills remain and no new offense type, offense date, charge or certification recital appears.

The repair added completeness dispositions to selection controls and glyphAdvance:null metadata; it did not mark or write a protected field.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.detail: Current fixture bytes and writable-anchor geometry are byte-identical to VF23. The retained VF23 source-differential/geometry measurement therefore applies; current selection geometry is unchanged while glyph advance is explicitly null rather than guessed.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: Reread current participant-instructions.md after its delta. It still says the packet is not filed and no court has decided anything, stops when the § 260B.125 route does not fit, directs another packet for every other item-9 ground, and sends objections/contested hearings to the court/lawyer path. No outcome is promised.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: Current filing-instructions.md is byte-identical to VF23 and was reread against the current registry: file with the district court administrator in the county where the case was decided, the district court of adult certification, not juvenile court. The current product-wiring pointer to filing-instructions.md is absent despite the file existing; this is recorded as a governance observation and does not change the file contents or destination statement.

SERVICE.detail: Current EXP104 source and filing-instructions.md are unchanged and were reread. The guide still leaves service details blank until mailing, names the six required agencies from the printed form, supplies no invented method/deadline, and directs completion after service.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: This delta was reread directly. EXP104 page 1 Judicial District is now a measured drawn rule classified REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, and the current guide names it with the same district instruction as EXP102/EXP106/FEE102. Current reports/blanks.json has 13 form-level required entries; the controlling record still has 10 requiredBeforeFiling actions, all current guide text present.

ARTIFACTS.detail: Current canonical and boundary PDFs were rehashed as ccd5f00f… and c5f2e418… and match reports/rendered-artifacts.json and the existing raster receipt. The current actual-writes byte proof remains unchanged. No new PNG bodies were read; visualDefects is therefore null under the retained hash-matched receipt.

PAGE_ORDER.detail: Current rendered-artifacts.json is byte-identical to VF23: EXP102 pages 1–6, EXP104 pages 1–2, EXP106 pages 1–3 and FEE102 pages 1–6, 17 pages per fixture. No page or component order delta exists.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.detail: Current selection audit covers 95 controls: exactly two marked controls carry disposition selected_route_option and completenessDisposition null, one EXP102 item-9 box 2 and one FEE102 item-2 pleadings branch. The other ten EXP102 item-9 boxes have distinct printed-ground-specific reasons, NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE dispositions, and all ten are named in the current guide. Existing source-geometry measurement confirms the marked box positions; no mark moved.

The item-7 criminal-record table and EXP104 agency rows remain wholly withheld/blank; current guide still requires the participant’s full record and service addresses.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: Current FEE102 source hash, FEE102 bytes, fee guidance and fee-waiver component are unchanged from VF23. The guide states the fee applies unless a statutory/granted waiver, gives no invented amount, includes conditional FEE102 and excludes FEE103 except where the court requests detail. Product wiring still reports payment/sponsorship false and route closed; its FEE102 source tier remains exact_form_number despite the source receipt’s exact hash, a retained governance-record mismatch not a changed participant fee instruction.
